name: systemInfo
description: Returns host-process platform identifiers used by the `# Environment` block in the guest's system prompt. Three fields: `platform` (one of 'win32' | 'darwin' | 'linux', Node-style, as the system prompt's `Platform:` line prints it), `osVersion` (human-readable, e.g. 'Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200'), and `shell` (interpreter name only, e.g. 'bash', 'zsh', 'PowerShell'; empty when no shell is known). The guest treats missing fields as 'omit that line' — there is intentionally no JS-side fallback (UA parsing was rejected in favor of accurate host-process info or no info).
